clips.title: The story
paras: Verner Osgood needs black dragon whelp underbelly scales to settle his trade debt with Smith Argus of Goldshire. You gather them from young drakes wandering the crags south of Lakeshire. The scales settle Verner’s account and leave enough raw hide to craft a piece of gear.

Verner Osgood runs a forge on the outskirts of Lakeshire and often trades with craftsmen beyond the Redridge Mountains. Smith Argus of Goldshire sent him a shipment of horseshoes, but Verner is short on coin. Argus demands valuable dragonhide in payment: the highly prized, softer underbelly scales of the black dragon whelps nesting in the region. Without them, collectors may come from Elwynn Forest to claim the debt.

Black dragon whelps in the Redridge Mountains alarm the local defenders. Gnolls and orcs contest the roads, while the Black Dragonflight nests in the high peaks and its brood wanders the skies south of Lake Everstill. The young predators’ underbelly scales are tough yet pliable. Armorers, smiths, and leatherworkers across the kingdom prize them, if they dare to harvest them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire. If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... And have enough left to fashion something for you.
Black dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander. You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon. Have you found those scales yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks! These will get me out of debt to Argus...
